Single JavaScript entry bundles can emit lazy chunks. The clarification does not establish one physical output file.

Admin endpoints exist. The phrase admin module health management has no confirmed dedicated endpoint mapping.
Auth migration modes select EMS2, EMS3, or dual reads. A source declaration does not select the deployed mode.

Current interceptor metadata and helper calls exceed deterministic routing support. Source review retains the logical contract with unresolved transport.
